mechanism.tracker: scripts/orchestration/lane_status.py (read-only; state derived from workflow journals, runner outputs, validation/ files, and the fired-trigger ledger; idempotent)

daemon.event_log: <scratchpad>/orchestration/events.log (append-only: DAEMON_START/EXIT, STATE transitions into terminal states, TRIGGER_READY on each transition into the ready set, ALERT STALE_CLAIM / LAUNCH_UNCONFIRMED)
daemon.previous: v1 daemon PID 27068 (12:50:51Z-12:57:29Z), replaced (not edited in place) to announce READY on transitions and to raise alerts

wake.tool: harness Monitor tailing events.log (filter: TRIGGER_READY, ALERT, DAEMON_START/EXIT, TRACKER_ERROR, done_open_issues, structural_fail, verified_provisional, error)
wake.expiry: 30 min (harness cap); re-armed at each expiry, when the daemon heartbeat is also checked

mechanism.actions: taken by the operator (this session) on a TRIGGER_READY event; each firing appended to docs/orchestration/fired_triggers.jsonl and committed

workflows.wf_02471fb6-48c: preliminary v1 forensics (completed; superseded by lanes 02, 03, 29)

survival.daemon + runners: survive tool-task deaths and session idle (detached); do NOT survive container reclamation
survival.monitor: harness task; expires every 30 min and is re-armed; lost if the session ends
survival.workflows: run inside this session; resumable only in the same session (resumeFromRunId); lost on container reclamation

restart_semantics: On any wake or resume: check the daemon heartbeat (< 3 min) and PID; if dead, start a new daemon (state is re-derived). Triggers with a live claim (CLAIMED/LAUNCHED/VERIFIED) are never READY, so a restart can never relaunch them; STALE_CLAIM / LAUNCH_UNCONFIRMED alerts are resolved by the operator with evidence (LAUNCHED recovered, or FAILED + new attempt). Runner death shows as missing keys in the pinned structural check; missing shards are reported to the owner, never silently rerun.

2026-09-26T12:56:55Z: during the migration to the transactional ledger, the v1 daemon ran the tracker after it had switched to the (still empty) v2 ledger and before the reconstructed claims were written; it announced TRIGGER_READY T_O4_ESCALATE:ds_staged_n2_n_exc_johnsonlow. No action was taken; the reconstructed LAUNCHED claim removed it from the ready set and the claim CLI refuses a second claim. This is the failure mode the transactional rule guards against.
